external_collaboration.evidence_quote: At Browns Pharmacy, your health and wellbeing are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’re proud to offer a private weight loss service in partnership with Nuumad—providing safe, effective, and medically supported weight management tailored to you.

We not only support you whilst on the medication but with our partners MAINTAIN we embrace NICE guidelines and offer follow up support, meaning our patients are prepared for life after the medication to keep their weight loss results for good.

How do MAINTAIN achieve this? They have experts from every field that have provided the content for their platform. LES MILLS global fitness brand deliver their physical health support, ALEVERE Nutrition engage to ensure you remain nourished and consume the right food to support fat loss and MIND OVER MASS, specialists in recovery from obesity through therapy, provide cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) and compassion focussed therapy (CFT) to ensure you are mentally prepared to protect your wei
